from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A person or entity involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="Full name of the party")
    role: str = Field(description="Role in the current proceeding, e.g., 'Appellant', 'Appellee'")

class MonetaryFact(BaseModel):
    """A specific monetary amount mentioned in the ruling."""
    amount: str = Field(description="The amount, e.g., '5800 元'")
    purpose: str = Field(description="What the money is for, e.g., 'Court Fees', 'Compensation'")
    borne_by: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost")
    recipient: str | None = Field(description="Who receives the payment")

class Verdict(BaseModel):
    """The court's decision or procedural outcome."""
    action: str = Field(description="The action taken, e.g., 'Maintain', 'Dismiss', 'Withdraw'")
    outcome: str | None = Field(description="Specific outcome, e.g., 'Maintain Original Judgment'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text of the ruling section")

class CaseReference(BaseModel):
    """References to court cases or files."""
    number: str = Field(description="The case number, e.g., '（2023）辽 02 执异 1076 号'")
    court: str | None = Field(description="The court issuing the number")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of all parties mentioned with their roles")
    amounts: list[MonetaryFact] = Field(description="List of all monetary amounts and their context")
    verdicts: list[Verdict] = Field(description="List of court decisions or rulings extracted")
    case_refs: list[CaseReference] = Field(description="List of official case numbers or references")
